2) Invoicing: finance@redwood.com is the invoice inbox and our AP contact is Laura Bennett (cc'd). Please address invoices to: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Payable.
3) Vendor portal / tax forms: if you can upload the W9 to our vendor portal that speeds processing. Portal link is in our procurement site (I can share a direct invite if needed).

Samantha — if Net 30 is acceptable to Redwood finance we'll proceed with Net 30 unless we need to escalate. If you'd prefer earlier payment, let us know and I can escalate to procurement leadership.
